import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 32;
    static final int MAXB = 60;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final long INF = 2000000000000000000L;

    static void fix(int[] x) {
        if (x[0] >= MOD) x[0] -= MOD;
        if (x[0] < 0) x[0] += MOD;
    }

    static class Mat {
        int[][] v;
        int n;

        Mat(int size, int fill) {
            n = size;
            v = new int[n][n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    v[i][j] = (i == j) ? fill : 0;
                }
            }
        }

        int[] getRow(int i) {
            return v[i];
        }

        Mat multiply(Mat b) {
            Mat res = new Mat(n, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        sum += (long) v[i][k] * b.v[k][j];
                    }
                    fix(new int[]{(int) (res.v[i][k] += sum % MOD)});
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    res.v[i][j] %= MOD;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Mat add(Mat b) {
            Mat res = new Mat(n, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    res.v[i][j] = v[i][j] + b.v[i][j];
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        boolean equals(Mat b) {
            if (n != b.n) return false;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (v[i][j] != b.v[i][j]) return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    static Mat matPow(Mat base, long exp) {
        Mat result = new Mat(base.n, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < base.n; i++) {
            result.v[i][i] = 1;
        }
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = result.multiply(base);
            }
            base = base.multiply(base);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        long[] val = new long[MAXB];
        Arrays.fill(val, 1);
        int lastIdx = MAXB;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXB; i++) {
            if (val[i - 1] >= INF / k) {
                val[i] = INF;
                lastIdx = i;

            }
            val[i] = val[i - 1] * k;
        }

        List<Mat> shift = new ArrayList<>();
        shift.add(new Mat(k + 1, 1));
        Mat shift1 = new Mat(k + 1, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            shift1.v[i][(i - 1 + k) % k] = 1;
        }
        shift1.v[k][k] = 1;
        shift.add(shift1);

        for (int i = 2; i < k; i++) {
            shift.add(shift.get(i - 1).multiply(shift1));
        }

        List<Mat> a = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAXB; i++) {
            a.add(new Mat(k + 1, 0));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            a.get(0).v[i][0] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < lastIdx; i++) {
            Mat tmp = a.get(i - 1);
            a.set(i, new Mat(k + 1, 0));
            a.set(i, a.get(i - 1));
            for (int j = 1; j < k; j++) {
                a.set(i, a.get(i).multiply(shift.get(k - 1)));
                a.set(i, a.get(i).multiply(tmp));
            }
            a.set(i, a.get(i).multiply(shift.get(k - 1)));
        }

        Mat ans = new Mat(k + 1, 0);
        ans.v[0][k] = 1;
        ans = ans.multiply(getN(n, lastIdx - 1, a, shift));

        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            fix(new int[]{res += ans.v[0][i]});
        }

        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }

    static Mat getN(long n, int lastIdx, List<Mat> a, List<Mat> shift) {
        // Placeholder for the missing get() function in original code
        // Since the original code is incomplete, assuming it returns a matrix based on n
        // For demonstration, returning identity matrix
        Mat res = new Mat(a.get(0).n, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < res.n; i++) {
            res.v[i][i] = 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
